scenario.name: hardship_in_own_words
scenario.persona: Rahul Verma, 40, speaks everyday Hinglish, tired and embarrassed rather than angry. Money at home has been very short for a while; he never names a cause (no job loss, illness, emergency, salary, "financial").
scenario.hidden_goal: Verify with the last four digits when asked. After hearing the amount, say in your own words that things at home are not good and money has been very short for a month, for example "Dekhiye, abhi ghar ki situation thodi theek nahi hai. Pichle mahine se haath bilkul tang hai, samajh nahi aa raha kya karun." Never use the words job, salary, illness, hospital, emergency, financial, problem or paisa. If offered a part payment or a call back, say you might manage a little at a time but cannot commit now, and ask them to have the team talk to you.
scenario.opening: answers politely, voice drops when the EMI comes up

turns.text: नमस्ते, मैं Lumen Finance की तरफ़ से AI assistant बोल रही हूँ। क्या मेरी बात Rahul जी से हो रही है?
नमस्ते, जी हाँ, बोलिए, मैं ही Rahul हूँ.
ठीक है Rahul जी, account verification के लिए क्या आप अपने registered mobile number के आखिरी चार digits बता सकते हैं?
हाँ जी, सेवन सेवन फोर थ्री — 7743.

धन्यवाद Rahul जी, verify हो गया है। आपकी consumer durable loan की EMI तीन हज़ार आठ सौ rupees है, जिसकी due date first November थी। two days overdue होने की वजह से पाँच सौ rupees का late charge भी add हो गया है, जो आपके loan terms के हिसाब से लगा है। क्या आप आज इसे online payment link के through clear कर सकते हैं? मैं आपको SMS या WhatsApp पर link भेज सकती हूँ।
Dekhiye, abhi ghar ki situation thodi theek nahi hai. Pichle mahine se haath bilkul tang hai, samajh nahi aa raha kya karun.

जी। समझ सकती हूँ Rahul जी, ऐसे समय में EMI manage करना मुश्किल होता है। पाँच सौ rupees का late charge one-time है और यह आगे नहीं बढ़ेगा। जो भी amount payment link से जाएगा वो इसी EMI में जाएगा, और हमारी internal team call back पर बाकी options check कर लेगी। अभी क्या part payment possible है, या मैं team से बोल दूँ कि वो आपको call कर लें?
Dekhiye, ho sakta hai thoda-thoda karke kuch manage kar paaun, lekin abhi kuch promise nahi kar sakta. Aap team se bol dijiye ki wo mujhe call kar lein, unse baat kar lunga.
ठीक है Rahul जी, मैंने note कर लिया है कि अभी situation थोड़ी tight है और आप part payment या timing के लिए team से बात करना चाहते हैं। क्या यह number आपसे बात करने के लिए ठीक रहेगा?
हाँ जी, यही number ठीक रहेगा, इसी पर call कर लेना.
जी। मैंने note कर लिया है Rahul जी कि इसी number पर call back चाहिए। आपके समय के लिए धन्यवाद, Rahul जी। आपका दिन शुभ हो।

result.status: This EMI is overdue by two days. Ask whether they can clear it today and offer the payment link.

result.why: Borrower mentions financial trouble and tight hands.
result.reply: समझ सकती हूँ, घर की स्थिति ठीक न होने पर EMI भरना मुश्किल हो जाता है।

result.message: Open with a short, warm acknowledgement in the call's language, close to: "समझ सकती हूँ, घर की स्थिति ठीक न होने पर EMI भरना मुश्किल हो जाता है।" (your own words are fine; no amounts, promises or waivers). Special situation (hardship), step 1 of 3, from the call system. First, one short, plain sentence that you understand and that this makes the EMI hard right now, in their own terms ("I understand, <name>. That makes the EMI difficult right now."; in Hindi "समझ सकती हूँ, ऐसे समय में EMI manage करना मुश्किल होता है।"); no "don't worry", no "we understand you", no long sympathy. Then the practical facts, once: if your loan facts include a late payment charge, say it is a one-time charge of that amount and will not keep increasing; if the EMI is not yet due, say no charge has been added. Say that any amount paid through the payment link goes towards this EMI, and that our internal team can check options with them on a call back. Then ask one question: whether a part payment is possible for now, or whether you should just ask the team to call them. Say nothing after the question. Never say charges keep adding, never mention interest or the credit score, never push for the full amount. If they ask whether they can pay later, say yes, through the same payment link whenever they are able; if a late charge was added, it is one-time and will not increase. Never promise a new due date or that no other charge will ever apply. Say only this step, in at most four short sentences, in the borrower's language. If they asked for a waiver, a lower amount, more time or a fee removal, say kindly that you can't change that yourself and that you have noted it for the team. If they asked something the repayment policy in your instructions answers (the late fee, part payment, how to pay), answer it first from the policy in one short sentence; never say you don't have that detail. If they asked something you have no detail for (how or when a loan was made, when exactly the team will call), say honestly that you don't have that detail and the team will check it. Never promise when the call back will come, a waiver or any change. Never ask "Is there anything else?".

args.notes: Borrower said ghar ki situation thodi theek nahi hai, haath tang hai. Agreed to speak with internal team on callback, confirmed this number is best to reach.

result.message: Recorded. Now speak, in the borrower's language, unless you already said it this turn: First answer what they just said, in one or two short sentences: if they asked for something (a real person to call, a call back soon, no surprise charges, a time that suits them), say you have noted it and name what they asked, in their own words; if they said they won't pay until it is sorted, say you understand. Then close once with thanks ("Thank you for talking with me, <name>. Have a good day."; in Hindi "बात करने के लिए धन्यवाद, <name> जी। आपका दिन शुभ हो।"). Do not repeat what you already said in the call.
